marks.gloss_en: מה בחייהן כך, במיתתן על אחת כמה וכמה -- if the righteous can do this (a mountain rising) in their lifetime, in their death all the more
דאמר רבי חמא בר חנינא: גדולים צדיקים במיתתן יותר מבחייהן
שנאמר: ויגע האיש בעצמות אלישע ויחי -- his own derivation
R' Chama bar Chanina: the righteous are greater in their death than in their life
והתניא: הלוקח פירות מן השוק לאכילה ונמלך עליהן לבהמה ... אלא אם כן עישר -- a corroborating baraita (no SupportKind names this והתניא)
התם הא אתמר עלה -- R' Yochanan's limitation (= p_ry_lo_shanu_livhema): only if bought for an animal from the start
R' Yochanan: this was taught only where he bought them initially for the animal; if he bought them for people and changed his mind for the animal, he must tithe
וכתיב: אל תלחם את לחם רע עין -- his own verse
R' Pinchas ben Yair to Rebbi: do you think I am vowed from benefit from Jews? Israel are holy -- some want to host and have not, some have and want not; you want and you have
דאמר רבי חנינא: מימי לא שאלני אדם על מכת פרדה לבנה וחיה
והא קחזינא דחיי! -- we see such people live
אימא: וחיית (= p_eima_vechayat)
והא קחזינא דמיתסי! -- we see the wound heal
דחיוורן ריש כרעייהו קא אמרינן -- we speak of those white at the top of their legs
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: why are they [the mules] called yemim (Gen 36:24)? because their terror lies upon creatures
שנאמר: מה' מצעדי גבר כוננו -- his own derivation
R' Chanina: no one bruises his finger below unless it is proclaimed above
ומי מיחייבא? והתנן: הלוקח ... לבהמה ... פטור מהדמאי
the mishna: one who buys for seed or for an animal, flour for hides, oil for a lamp or for greasing vessels, is exempt from demai
ודילמא לקיומי ביה ברכתא דאליהו, דכתיב: ויהי נא פי שנים ברוחך אלי? -- perhaps the revival fulfilled Elijah's blessing of a double portion, and shows nothing about the dead
אי הכי, היינו דתניא: על רגליו עמד ולביתו לא הלך? -- a revival that did not last cannot count for the blessing (= p_al_raglav_amad)
the baraita: he stood on his feet but did not go home [he did not truly live on]
והאמר רבי יוחנן: למה נקרא שמן כשפים -- שמכחישין פמליא של מעלה! -- sorcery does work
שאני רבי חנינא דנפישא זכותיה -- R' Chanina is different, his merit being great
'there is none beside Him' (Deut 4:35) -- R' Chanina: not even sorcery
R' Pinchas ben Yair (when his donkey refused the barley until it was tithed): this poor creature goes to do its Maker's will and you feed it untithed produce!
but now I am in a hurry, for I am occupied with a mitzva; when I return I will come in to you
seeing white mules at the entrance: the angel of death is in this man's house, and I should dine with him?
Rebbi: I will sell them -- R' Pinchas ben Yair: 'do not put a stumbling block before the blind' (Lev 19:14)
I will declare them ownerless -- you multiply the damage
R' Yochanan: Elijah's double portion was fulfilled when Elisha cured Naaman's leprosy, which equals death, as it says 'let her not be as one dead' (Num 12:12)
R' Pinchas ben Yair never broke bread that was not his own, and from his maturity never benefited even from his father's table
